raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly shifted the target language from Latin to Old French, conflating the vernacular of West Francia around 800 A.D. with the etymological origin of the surname. “Sylvester” ultimately derives from Latin (silvestris/silva), and surnames were not yet standardized in 800 A.D.; invoking an Old French form as the origin is anachronistic and misinterprets the question’s context (the Carolingian era where Latin predominated).
